title: Fan Cowl Door Hinge Bracket and Seal Retention Improvement on VDK-56B Nacelles
abstract: Reinforced fan cowl door hinge bracket and a captive seal retention strip, introduced after hinge land elongation and seal loss were found on cowls opened frequently for line maintenance.

sections.reason: Fan cowl doors on aircraft in short sector operation are opened between three and five hundred times a year, an order of magnitude more often than the design case assumed. Inspections in 2018 found hinge land elongation on sixty-one of two hundred and twelve cowls surveyed, and in nineteen cases the fore and aft seal had partially departed and was found lodged in the cowl cavity. Seal loss is not itself a safety issue but it changes the fan compartment ventilation path and it has twice preceded a nacelle overheat indication. The elongation is a slow failure that no scheduled task was catching.
sections.description: The hinge bracket is replaced by the reinforced mount link D7110112111633, which carries a bushed hinge land instead of a plain bore. The fore and aft seal IB779874-66 is retained in a new captive strip that is riveted rather than bonded, and the corner bracket NY814392-02 is added at each end of the strip to stop peel initiation. Shear head bolts AES484712-68 secure the mount link to the existing pylon hard points. The nozzle at FIN 71EN is unaffected but is disturbed for access. Work is in zones 451, 455 and 462 with the cowls removed and supported on a trestle. Detail of the harness routing that crosses the hinge line is on drawing D71101167094.
sections.effects: Mass increase of 3.6 kilograms per nacelle, symmetric across the two engines, with no significant balance effect. No electrical load change. One way interchangeable: a modified cowl fits an unmodified pylon but an unmodified cowl must not be hung on a modified hinge because the bush and the pin diameters differ. The hinge land inspection becomes a general visual at each cowl opening instead of a detailed inspection at every C check. The cowl repair task and the parts figure require re-issue.
sections.embodiment_note: Production cut-in at MSN Z08701 in February 2020. Retrofit is done with the cowls off, one nacelle at a time, and is quoted at sixteen hours per nacelle including seal cure. Kits contain the mount link pair, the seal strip, the corner brackets and the bolt set.

type_data.production_impact: Cut-in at MSN Z08701, nacelle supplier absorbed the change in a normal build break
